thesis: The Abyss converts each upkeep into compulsory creature attrition, rewarding decks built around artifacts, resilient threats, or no creatures at all.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, destroy target nonartifact creature that player controls of their choice. It can't be regenerated.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The Abyss became a classic control and prison tool whose very name came to describe repeatable creature suppression rather than a conventional removal spell.

playbook.role: Construct the deck so the sacrifice effect is asymmetrical, then protect the enchantment while the opponent’s board disappears one creature at a time. Sequence disposable creatures carefully if you must keep one important threat.
